_note: Numbers-only merge file for the integrator (Marc). Keyed by the 11 exact equipment ids in live data/items.json (Ollie + integrator). Names, descs, slots, tier, equippable_by, starting_for and in_shop are copied here as reference and must stay in sync with the live file; do not invent ids or names. Merge mods, element, price, sellable, sell_price, resist and ink onto the matching live equipment entry by id. Equipment bonuses are applied in a later patch with Jared (save fields). Flat bonuses only, sized from Jake's L1-L6 ranges and damage formula raw = max(a*0.25, 2a - d). Approved by Jake on 2026-11-15.
sell_rule: Sell price is floor(price/2) (SPEC 7) for sellable stock. Starter gear (starting_for set) and any piece with in_shop false is unsellable (sellable: false, sell_price: 0), because the demo has no replacement in the shop.

mod_policy.source: Jake, party.json stat_table, demo L1 to about L6
mod_policy.damage: raw = max(a*0.25, 2a - d); each atk point is about 2 damage, each def point blocks about 1

tier_rationale.weapon_t1: Starter weapons: +2 atk (top of Jake's +0 to +2 band). Benika also gets +2 mat, since her Seal Art scales off mat. Starting gear is real, but Inkwing's roughly +50% atk stays the spike.
tier_rationale.weapon_t2: Best demo weapons: +8 atk, Jake's cap. Benika gets +4 atk (the unused mid-tier budget, on her weaker physical side) and +8 mat. There is no mid-tier weapon id in the 11, so a dedicated +4 mid weapon is unused.
tier_rationale.armor_t1: Jake's tier-1 armor: +3 def. Sold at Kōbō Tsuru so the party can buy a first layer in town.
tier_rationale.armor_t2: Jake's tier-2 armor: +6 def, plus +3 mdf on this one optional mdf piece (lacquer 'beads ink off'). Both armors are all-party, so Gonzō's +8 def option is unused.
tier_rationale.accessory: Jake asked for a mix of all three types: prayer_mala is the stat piece (mdf +4, Gonzō's starter; 'steadies the breath'); paper_charm is the one ink accessory (+1 ink per Stroke hit landed, no battle-start ink; shop stock so the demo can feel the 18-to-21 fill); lantern_bell is dusk resist x0.75 after the elements.json chart ('keeps the grey at bay'; Blotlings are dusk).

equipment.name: Red-Cord Katana
equipment.rationale: Itsuki starter. +2 atk, top of Jake's +0 to +2 starter band, on L1-L6 atk 22-35.

equipment.name: Prayer-Slip Bow
equipment.rationale: Benika starter. +1 atk and +2 mat (Jake: mat as well as atk), both inside the +0 to +2 starter band. Seal Art scales off mat; Strokes still use atk.

equipment.name: Iron-Banded Staff
equipment.rationale: Gonzō starter. +2 atk, top of the starter band, on L1-L6 atk 20-32. Strokes and his Seal Art both scale off atk.

equipment.name: Seal-Edge Katana
equipment.rationale: Itsuki's best demo weapon. +8 atk, Jake's cap, so Inkwing's roughly +50% atk stays the bigger spike.

equipment.name: Crane-Feather Bow
equipment.rationale: Benika's best demo weapon. +8 mat (cap, for Seal Arts) and +4 atk (the mid-tier budget, on her weaker physical side). No mid-tier bow id exists in the 11.

equipment.name: Bell-Bronze Staff
equipment.rationale: Gonzō's best demo weapon. +8 atk, Jake's cap. Strokes and Stone Owl Verse both scale off atk.

equipment.name: Layered Washi Vest
equipment.rationale: All-party tier-1 armor. +3 def (Jake). Sold at Kōbō Tsuru for 40 mon, about 1.5 average fights.

equipment.name: Lacquered Haori
equipment.rationale: All-party tier-2 armor. +6 def (Jake), plus +3 mdf on this one optional mdf piece. Not Gonzō-only, so the +8 def option is unused.

equipment.name: Prayer-Bead Mala
equipment.rationale: Gonzō starter, type (a) stat accessory. +4 mdf (Jake's mdf budget). 'Counting them steadies the breath.' spd left alone; his role is to be slow.

equipment.name: Folded Paper Charm
equipment.rationale: Type (c), the one demo ink accessory. +1 ink per Stroke hit landed, which takes a good chain's fill from 18 to 21 (6 turns down to 5). No flat ink at battle start. Shop stock so the party can buy it mid-demo. Paper/ink flavor.

equipment.name: Lantern Bell
equipment.rationale: Type (b) elemental resist. Dusk damage x0.75 after the elements.json chart. 'Its ring keeps the grey at bay.' Blotlings are dusk; Hollow Lantern is gale and the Smudge Ronin is stone, so this is a fodder-fight resist, not a boss one. No spd; Jake's spd cap is +2 and this piece spends its budget on the resist.
